# Avalanche C-Chain — Runtime, Contracts & Onchain Economy
**SlowMoonShip: Gateway to Onchain Data · v0.2**
C-Chain is one EVM execution chain within the Avalanche Primary Network. This dashboard measures C-Chain-specific runtime, contract activity, fees and on-chain asset flows. It is **not** a measurement of all Avalanche L1s; for the network view see the companion dashboard.

## Latest Complete UTC Day
The four counters above cover the **last complete UTC calendar day**, not a rolling 24-hour window. Active senders are distinct addresses initiating successful transactions; no contract filter is applied and the metric is not a people count. Daily fees equal `gas_used × effective gas_price / 10^18` AVAX and include failed transactions.

## Runtime
Transactions include success and failure. Active senders count only successful top-level transaction initiators. The intensity chart includes both all-transactions / successful-senders and successful-transactions / successful-senders; these populations differ. Block intervals are observed timestamp differences between consecutive blocks, not finality latency.

## Fees / Burn
Daily fees equal `sum(gas_used × effective gas_price / 10^18)` AVAX over complete UTC days; failed transactions are included. The new **fee burn** series equals the same daily total — this is the **observed C-Chain transaction-fee burn only** and is **not** total Avalanche network AVAX burn, **not** net issuance, and **not** supply change. Failed transactions contribute to the burn because gas is consumed even on revert. The cumulative line is within the 90-day window.

## Contracts & Applications
A contract is a deduplicated nonempty-code creation-trace address deployed no later than the transaction. Only top-level destinations are ranked; internal calls are not extra transactions. Top 10/20 shares use all C-Chain transactions as denominator. **Deployments are not developers**; addresses are not people; protocol attribution from address alone is unsupported.

## Stablecoins & Onchain Economy
Four explicit contracts: native USDC, native USDt, bridged USDC.e, bridged USDT.e. Positive ERC-20 transfers only; zero-address mint/burn events excluded. **Volume is gross transfer flow**, not net capital inflow, payments, TVL or stablecoin supply. Token-level sender and transaction counts must not be summed into ecosystem totals. Transfer senders can include contracts.

## C-Chain Interchain Activity
The trend and peer table show decoded Teleporter send and receive events observed **on C-Chain only**. The C-Chain endpoint view shows which peers C-Chain exchanges messages with — it is **not** full Avalanche interchain topology and the local send/receive ratio is **not** a delivery or completion rate.

## Limitations
This dashboard cannot reliably answer:
- Avalanche network-wide activity (C-Chain is one execution chain)
- Other Avalanche L1 runtime / fees / contracts / assets
- Per-sender people counts or KYC identity
- Protocol attribution from address alone
- Stablecoin supply or net flow
- AVAX burn beyond C-Chain execution fees
- NFT analytics, token price, market cap, TVL, developer count

For the Avalanche network-level view, see the companion dashboard **Avalanche Network — L1s, Validators & Interchain Activity**.

## Methodology & Data Notes
**Data sources:** `avalanche_c.transactions`, `avalanche_c.blocks`, `avalanche_c.creation_traces`; `tokens.transfers`; decoded C-Chain Teleporter send + receive events.

**Time:** Complete UTC days, current day excluded. Eight production query pages expose a 7 / 30 / 90 / 365-day enum and default to 90 days. The new fee burn query is hardcoded to 90 days to match the dashboard render.

**Freshness:** Raw bounds checked through 2026-09-11 06:36:07 UTC; first blocks 2020-09-23 11:02:06 UTC, first transactions 2020-09-23 12:14:43 UTC. Bounds do not prove uninterrupted ingestion. Dune execution timestamps govern individual chart results.

**Validation:** 90-day transaction hashes and block hashes unique at daily grain; required transaction fields present; 7-day block-hash joins checked; selected stablecoin transfers have no duplicate keys or missing USD prices; Teleporter event keys checked; trend aggregated to one row per UTC day and direction; new fee burn query has zero duplicate_hashes and zero missing_required across the 90-day window.

**Limitations:** addresses are not natural-person users; gross stablecoin flow is not net flow; AVAX burn is C-Chain execution fee only and not network-wide; per-L1 / per-sender activity are not C-Chain scope; selected stablecoins are an explicit four-contract allowlist (native + bridged forms separate).
